1. 1907 draft scheme. . . . . . .
2. Five Neutral Powers. The Assembly of the League of Nations. (art. 5)
3. Interparliamentary Union. The contracting Powers during a session of the Peace Conference. (art. 12)
4. International Law Union. The Assembly of the League of Nations. (art. 3)
5. Denmark. The Assembly of the League of Nations. (art. 2)
6. Norway. Same as Denmark. (art. 1)
7. Netherlands. Permanent administrative Council composed of representatives of the Members of the League of Nations at . . . and of the Minister of Foreign Affairs at . . . (arts. 2 and 17)
8. Sweden. An Electoral Assembly wherever every state which is a Member of the League of Nations is represented by its foremost representative in the P. C. A., or, in the event of his being prevented from serving, the representative nearest to him in order who is available. (art. 2)
9. Switzerland. The Conference of States (a body analogous to the Assembly of the League of Nations). (art. 13)
10. Italy. Each State appoints one Judge.
11. Germany. The Congress of States. (art. 14)
12. Austria. A plenary Assembly of the Members of the League. (art. 13)
